story.title: Do Emmetts Dream of Llamanian Sheep?
story.blurb: A ship-wide blackout leaves Emmett on the end of Sanya's leash, and a feverish withdrawal dream pulls him into a surreal park of weddings, bees and old fears.

lines.text: The ship fell silent the night the power went out. It was as if the crew needed electricity to remain social, which is a bit surprising given their close interactions. Somehow, everyone forgot about supplying the ship with dark matter, and very slowly power drained. They were essentially dead weight, aside from the backup generators, which were only to be used to thrust the ship in the direction of a fueling station. Like a spell, the lack of lighting made everyone pretty tired. Seth, Vargas, Valentina, and your mom all went to their rooms, leaving our star pilot alone within the den. Emmett was reading a book upon one of the many sofas before the power went out, so he was a little irritated.

"Well, that's great. Anyone got a light? I'm currently in the middle of something," Emmett groaned into his comms. Sanya was in the laundry block when the lights went out. Immediately, she cracked Garrick and shook him like a glowstick, producing light and generating a Squoatling mask.
